text:
Leah: Quick heads up — VoltEdge asked for explicit SI co-sell routing for appliance listings in the cloud marketplace.
Nikhil: good catch. we should avoid marketplace and SI stomping on each other.
Suresh: propose: 'first-touch' window = 5 business days for marketplace when source==marketplace_listing, else SI gets immediate ownership if si_tag present.
Leah: add co-owner semantics: marketplace gets marketplace_co tag when SI owns; that tag expires after 5 days if no activity.
Dev: technical: we can implement as webhooks + an intake service. sample API call to set co-owner:
Dev: ```
POST /intake/v1/claim
{ "lead_id": "L-99321", "owner_type": "marketplace", "partner": "VoltEdge" }
```
Nikhil: also need an auto-match for existing SI relationships: fuzzy on domain + manual account link flag. threshold 0.85.
Suresh: gating rule for hw-appliance: if estimated_hardware_cost + software_commitment > 250000 then require 'joint-kickoff' and create a private Slack thread with AM+SE+SI.
Leah: edge cases: multi-SI account (multiple SI tags) -> escalate to #partnerships with summary and let AM pick within 48 hours.
Dev: added a CLI for reps: `rw-intake claim --lead L-99321 --as marketplace --partner VoltEdge --notes "appliance listing"`
intake-bot: automated: Rule set created: voltedge_appliance_v2. Auto-escalation scheduled if multi-SI detected. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/voltedge_appliance_v2
Leah: Ops: enforcement job should run hourly, post a summary for flips. Who owns the cron? @Suresh
Suresh: I'll own the cron + metrics; will add a prometheus alert if flip rate > 5%/day.
Nikhil: SLA wording draft: marketplace rep must engage within 3 business days or ownership flips; SI must acknowledge within 48 hours or AM escalates.
Leah: I'll PR the wording to the intake-rules repo and link here.
Dev: putting up a prototype branch now: github.com/redwood/integrations/voltedge-intake
Leah: thanks team. plan: pilot for 2 weeks, measure double-claim rate and time-to-first-response. :rocket:
